title: CaP Cement is Equivalent to Iliac Bone Graft in Filling of Large Metaphyseal Defects
brief_summary: CaP Cement is Equivalent to Iliac Bone Graft in Filling of Large Metaphyseal Defects
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* distal radius malunion with dorsal deformity, disability and pain.

Exclusion Criteria:

* age under 18 years, bad health, inflammatory arthritis and radio-carpal osteoarthritis.
condition: Dorsal Malunion of the Distal Radius
